points.description: States one valid piece of missing information needed to replicate the experiment, such as the volume/amount of vinegar used, the type or concentration of vinegar, the size/shape/surface area of the samples, the container size/material, the temperature or environmental conditions, the rinsing volume, or the drying conditions.

States a second distinct valid piece of missing information needed to replicate the experiment, different from the first, using any of the acceptable examples or another clearly relevant missing detail.

States a third distinct valid piece of missing information needed to replicate the experiment, different from the first two, using any of the acceptable examples or another clearly relevant missing detail.

rubric.notes: Full marks require three distinct, relevant pieces of additional information needed for replication. One or two relevant pieces earn partial marks according to the points above; no relevant missing information earns no marks. Accept equivalent wording and other valid missing details not listed, as long as they are clearly needed to repeat the procedure.
